sql: SELECT 1 AS a,2 AS b UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT 3 AS b,4 AS c ORDER BY a NULLS LAST
SELECT 1 AS a,2 AS b UNION BY NAME SELECT 2 AS b,1 AS a ORDER BY a
SELECT 1 AS A UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT 2 AS a ORDER BY A
SELECT NULL AS d UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT CAST('2024-01-02' AS DATE) AS d ORDER BY d NULLS LAST
SELECT NULL AS a UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT NULL AS b ORDER BY a NULLS LAST
SELECT CAST('18446744073709551615' AS UBIGINT) AS v UNION BY NAME SELECT CAST('-1' AS BIGINT) AS v ORDER BY v
(SELECT 2 AS a,1 AS b UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 ORDER BY a LIMIT 1) UNION ALL BY NAME (SELECT 3 AS b,4 AS c) ORDER BY a NULLS LAST
WITH x AS (SELECT 1 AS a UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT 2 AS b) SELECT * FROM x UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT 3 AS c ORDER BY a NULLS LAST,b NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS k UNION ALL SELECT 2) SELECT k,(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT t.k AS a UNION BY NAME SELECT t.k AS b) u) AS n FROM t ORDER BY k
SELECT 1 AS a,2 AS A UNION BY NAME SELECT 3 AS a
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x = ANY(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x = ALL(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x <> ANY(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x <> ALL(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x < ANY(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x < ALL(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x <= ANY(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x <= ALL(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x > ANY(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x > ALL(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x >= ANY(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS x UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT x,x >= ALL(SELECT 2 AS y UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL) AS v FROM t ORDER BY x NULLS LAST
SELECT CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)=ANY(SELECT 1 WHERE FALSE) AS a,CAST(NULL AS INTEGER)=ALL(SELECT 1 WHERE FALSE) AS b,5>ANY(SELECT 2 WHERE FALSE) AS c,5>ALL(SELECT 2 WHERE FALSE) AS d
SELECT 3>=SOME(SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4) AS v
SELECT 'b'>ANY(SELECT 'a' UNION ALL SELECT 'c') AS a,'b'<>ALL(SELECT 'a' UNION ALL SELECT 'c') AS b
SELECT CAST('NaN' AS DOUBLE)=ANY(SELECT CAST('NaN' AS DOUBLE)) AS a,CAST('NaN' AS DOUBLE)>ALL(SELECT CAST('1' AS DOUBLE)) AS b

WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS k UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT NULL),u AS (SELECT 1 AS k,2 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 1,NULL UNION ALL SELECT 3,4) SELECT t.k,t.k<ANY(SELECT v FROM u WHERE u.k=t.k) AS a,t.k<ALL(SELECT v FROM u WHERE u.k=t.k) AS b FROM t ORDER BY t.k NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS k UNION ALL SELECT 2),u AS (SELECT 1 AS k,3 AS v) SELECT k,k<ANY(SELECT sum(v) FROM u WHERE u.k=t.k) AS a,k<ALL(SELECT sum(v) FROM u WHERE u.k=t.k) AS b FROM t ORDER BY k
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS k UNION ALL SELECT 2),u AS (SELECT 1 AS k,3 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 1,4) SELECT k,k<ANY(SELECT v FROM u WHERE u.k=t.k ORDER BY v LIMIT 1) AS a FROM t ORDER BY k

b','^b','m') AS d,regexp_full_match('a
b','a.b','s') AS e
SELECT regexp_extract('a7','(a)([0-9])') AS a,regexp_extract('a7','(a)([0-9])',2) AS b,regexp_extract('ABC','[a-z]+','i') AS c,regexp_extract('x','(a)',1) AS d
SELECT regexp_replace('aba','a','X') AS a,regexp_replace('aba','a','X','g') AS b,regexp_replace('ab','(a)(b)','\2-\1') AS c
SELECT regexp_escape('a b-c!') AS v
SELECT regexp_matches(NULL,'x') AS a,regexp_extract(NULL,'x') AS b,regexp_replace('x',NULL,'a') AS c
SELECT array_length(regexp_extract_all('ab','(a)|(b)',1)) AS n,list_extract(regexp_extract_all('ab','(a)|(b)',1),1) AS a,list_extract(regexp_extract_all('ab','(a)|(b)',1),2) AS b
SELECT array_length(regexp_split_to_array('a,,b,',',')) AS n,list_extract(regexp_split_to_array('a,,b,',','),2) AS e,list_extract(regexp_split_to_array('αβ',''),-1) AS u
SELECT struct_extract(regexp_extract('ab','(a)(b)',['x','y']),'y') AS a,struct_extract(regexp_extract('z','(a)(b)',['x','y']),'x') AS b
SELECT array_length(string_split('','')) AS n,list_extract(string_split('',''),1) AS v,array_length(string_split(NULL,',')) AS z
SELECT array_length(string_split('中🙂文','')) AS n,list_extract(string_split('中🙂文',''),2) AS v,list_extract(string_split('a,b',','),0) AS z

SELECT id,regexp_matches(CAST(id AS VARCHAR),'^[0-9]+$') AS m,regexp_replace(CAST(id AS VARCHAR),'[0-9]','x','g') AS r,list_extract(string_split(CAST(id AS VARCHAR)||',x',','),2) AS s FROM {batch} ORDER BY id
SELECT round(CAST('1.25' AS DECIMAL(6,2)),NULL) AS n,round(CAST('1.25' AS DECIMAL(6,2)),abs(1)) AS r
SELECT coalesce(round(CAST('1.25' AS DECIMAL(6,2)),NULL),CAST('2.00' AS DECIMAL(6,2))) AS n
SELECT round(CAST('1.25' AS DECIMAL(6,2)),NULL) AS n UNION ALL SELECT CAST('2024-01-02' AS DATE) ORDER BY n NULLS LAST
SELECT DISTINCT round(CAST(id AS DECIMAL(8,2)),NULL) AS v FROM {batch}
SELECT CAST(TRUE AS FLOAT) AS f,CAST(FALSE AS DOUBLE) AS d,CAST(TRUE AS DECIMAL(8,2)) AS n,TRY_CAST(TRUE AS DECIMAL(1,1)) AS bad
SELECT CAST('0xff' AS UTINYINT) AS x,CAST('0b10_10' AS INTEGER) AS b,TRY_CAST('0xff' AS TINYINT) AS over,TRY_CAST('-0x1' AS BIGINT) AS bad,CAST('0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF' AS HUGEINT) AS h
SELECT date_part(lower('YEAR'),CAST('2024-02-29' AS DATE)) AS y,date_part('ye'||'ar',CAST('2024-02-29' AS DATE)) AS c
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS id,'YEAR' AS p UNION ALL SELECT 2,'EPOCH') SELECT id,date_part(lower(p),CAST('2024-01-02' AS DATE)) AS v FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT struct_extract(date_part(['year','epoch','isoyear'],CAST('2024-01-02' AS DATE)),'year') AS y,struct_extract(date_part(['year','epoch'],CAST('2024-01-02' AS DATE)),'epoch') AS e
SELECT CAST('2024-01-02 03:04:05 America/New_York' AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS t,CAST(timezone('America/New_York',CAST('2024-01-02 03:04:05' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS VARCHAR) AS s

SELECT date_part('year',CAST('infinity' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS y,date_part('epoch',CAST('infinity' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS e,date_part('julian',CAST('-infinity' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS j,CAST(date_trunc('year',CAST('infinity' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS VARCHAR) AS t
SELECT timezone('America/New_York',CAST('2024-01-02 03:04:05' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS t,timezone('America/New_York',CAST('2024-01-02 03:04:05+00' AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AS n
SELECT CAST(CAST('infinity' AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP_NS) AS p,CAST(CAST('-infinity' AS TIMESTAMP_NS) AS DATE) AS n
SELECT range FROM range(1+3) ORDER BY range
SELECT range FROM range(5,-1,-2) ORDER BY range
SELECT generate_series FROM generate_series(5,-1,-2) ORDER BY generate_series
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM range(CAST(NULL AS BIGINT))
WITH t AS (SELECT 2 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 4) SELECT n,r.i FROM t,range(n) AS r(i) ORDER BY n,r.i
WITH t AS (SELECT 2 AS n UNION ALL SELECT NULL) SELECT n,r.i FROM t LEFT JOIN LATERAL range(n) AS r(i) ON TRUE ORDER BY n NULLS LAST,r.i NULLS LAST
WITH t AS (SELECT 2 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 4) SELECT n,(SELECT count(*) FROM range(t.n)) AS c FROM t ORDER BY n
WITH t AS (SELECT 1 AS id,'a,b' AS s UNION ALL SELECT 2,NULL UNION ALL SELECT 3,'x') SELECT id,u.v FROM t LEFT JOIN unnest(string_split(s,',')) AS u(v) ON TRUE ORDER BY id,u.v NULLS LAST
SELECT u.v FROM unnest(list_value('a',NULL,'b')) AS u(v) ORDER BY u.v NULLS LAST
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM range(4097)
WITH t AS (SELECT 'missing.csv' AS p) SELECT * FROM t,read_csv(t.p)
SELECT d,ts FROM read_csv('{csv_dates}',header=true,dateformat='%d/%m/%Y',timestampformat='%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ORDER BY d
SELECT CAST(d AS VARCHAR) AS d,CAST(ts AS VARCHAR) AS ts FROM read_csv('{csv_dates}',header=true) ORDER BY d
SELECT n FROM read_csv('{csv_numbers}',header=true,auto_type_candidates=['SMALLINT','INTEGER']) ORDER BY n
SELECT n FROM read_csv('{csv_numbers}',header=true,auto_type_candidates=['VARCHAR']) ORDER BY n
SELECT d FROM read_csv('{csv_mixed}',header=true) ORDER BY d
SELECT n FROM read_csv('{csv_decimal}',header=true,auto_type_candidates=['DECIMAL']) ORDER BY n
